title: 双胞胎姐妹咖啡馆照片与动漫比较

prompt_en:
Goal: Create a vertical two-panel comparison image showing the same pair of beautiful twin sisters, Linlin and Lanlan, seated together at an outdoor European-style café, with the upper half rendered as a realistic photograph and the lower half rendered as a polished anime illustration based on the same composition.

Canvas: Tall vertical image, approximately 9:16 aspect ratio. Split the canvas horizontally into exactly 2 equal stacked panels with no large gap: top panel photorealistic, bottom panel anime style.

Layout and subjects: Show exactly 2 adult twin sisters seated shoulder-to-shoulder at a round café table, centered in both panels. They are framed from the waist or bust upward. Both have slim-to-curvy figures, warm light skin, dark brown to black hair, and relaxed café poses. The left sister has a chin-length bob haircut and wears a white sleeveless scoop-neck tank top with thin vertical black pinstripes. The right sister has long wavy dark hair and wears a black sleeveless scoop-neck tank top with thin horizontal white stripes. Their shoulders touch, and they sit in woven rattan café chairs.

Top panel: Photorealistic lifestyle photograph in bright midday sunlight. The sisters sit at a marble-topped round table; include exactly 2 visible coffee cups or small glasses near the bottom foreground. Background is a leafy boulevard café with trees, large patio umbrella overhead, wicker chairs, flower planters with white daisies, pedestrians, storefronts, and soft urban depth of field. Natural skin highlights, realistic fabric texture, realistic hair shine, documentary travel-photography feel.

Bottom panel: High-quality anime illustration of the same scene and pose, more saturated and clean-lined. Keep exactly 2 sisters, matching hair lengths and outfits from the top panel. Use glossy anime shading, warm sunlight, crisp line art, bright daisies in the foreground and sides, leafy branches overhead, lampposts, European street buildings, pedestrians, café awnings, and an umbrella pole centered above or between the sisters. The bottom foreground should show the curved edge of a café table.

Face treatment: In both panels, obscure the faces with simple soft-edged rectangular censor blocks, exactly 4 total face-obscuring rectangles: 2 in the photorealistic top panel and 2 in the anime bottom panel. The rectangles should be medium brown gradients matching skin tones and cover the facial features while leaving hair, shoulders, outfits, and pose visible.

Visual style: Top half realistic DSLR photo, bottom half modern detailed anime/comic rendering. Keep the composition aligned so the anime panel clearly echoes the photographic panel. Bright outdoor café atmosphere, lush greenery, white flowers, warm summer mood, attractive twin-sister character design.

Constraints: No text, no watermark, no logos. Do not add extra people in the foreground besides the 2 sisters. Preserve the exact two-panel structure and the exact count of 2 main women, 2 cups in the top panel, and 4 face-obscuring rectangles.\

prompt_en:
Goal: Create a realistic candid photo in a subway or underground station hallway showing a young woman posing beside a large digital birthday advertisement billboard for herself.

Canvas: Horizontal 16:9 photo, eye-level perspective, wide framing. Beige tiled station wall with grout lines and a polished gray floor. Fluorescent ceiling reflections and clean public-transit interior lighting.

Main subject: One young Korean woman stands on the left side of the frame, full body visible from head to upper thighs. She has long dark hair and wears a fitted black long-sleeve top, light blue high-waisted denim shorts with frayed hems, and a small black shoulder bag. Her face is covered by a rectangular soft blur privacy block. She smiles/poses toward the camera and points with both hands toward the billboard.

Billboard: One large horizontal digital screen mounted on the wall to the right, with a thick black frame. The billboard shows a pastel birthday fan-ad design for 윤슬. The design is pink on the left blending into blue on the right, with dreamy clouds, sparkles, hearts, bubbles, and a large portrait of the same woman on the right side of the billboard. The portrait face is also covered by a large rectangular soft blur privacy block.

Text content on billboard: Include exactly 6 visible text groups: 1) small English text “HAPPY BIRTHDAY” near the upper left, 2) very large Korean name “윤슬” centered-left in pink and blue bubble lettering, 3) date “1996.02.15” below the name, 4) pink ribbon label “여신 탄신일”, 5) small handwritten Korean line near the lower left, “세상에서 가장 빛나는 순간, 언제나 윤슬과 함께할게 ♡”, 6) handwritten Korean message on the right, “윤슬아, 생일 축하해! 너의 모든 순간을 응원해. 사랑해 ♡”.

Visual style: Photorealistic smartphone travel snapshot, natural station lighting, slight wide-angle lens, realistic reflections on the billboard glass, subtle depth of field but most elements readable. The birthday billboard should look professionally designed and luminous, while the surrounding subway wall remains neutral and realistic.

Constraints: Use exactly 1 posing woman, exactly 1 wall-mounted digital billboard, exactly 2 blurred face privacy rectangles, and exactly 6 billboard text groups. Do not add extra people, extra signs, watermarks, logos, or unrelated text.\

Canvas: 16:9 widescreen screenshot, approximately 1200×675 px, with the full PowerPoint application window visible. Use a light gray Windows/Office interface, Japanese ribbon labels, one slide thumbnail on the left, the main slide centered, status bar at the bottom, and a zoom level around 107%.

Include a search box near the top, a red Share button at top right, and a single slide thumbnail in the left navigation pane. The left half is a cream paper-like advertisement panel over a warm blurred café/table background, and the right half is a close-up photo of an iced matcha latte in a clear glass on a wooden tray, with soft natural window light, green leaves above, a bamboo whisk in the background, and warm brown tones. prompt_en:
Goal: Create a vertical Xiaohongshu-style 3D creator profile card for AI Fashion Creator, with a futuristic purple-black aesthetic, glossy glassmorphism panels, soft neon lighting, and a premium social-media portfolio layout.

Canvas: Portrait 9:16 mobile poster, dark charcoal-to-black background, rounded outer card with a subtle violet glow along the edges, high-contrast white typography, lavender accents, and soft bloom lighting. The overall look should feel like a polished 3D UI profile card, combining fashion editorial imagery with app-dashboard components.

Main subject: On the left side, place one full-body stylized 3D female fashion creator avatar floating slightly above the bottom, wearing a shiny iridescent lavender bomber jacket, black cropped top, black cargo jogger pants, and chunky white sneakers. Her hair is tied in a high messy bun, her face is intentionally softly blurred or anonymized, and she is surrounded by a glowing purple ring wrapping around her body plus several floating translucent purple orbs and crystal shapes.

Layout: Large headline block in the upper right reading “AI Fashion Creator” in bold white sans-serif type, with a subtitle underneath reading “Redefining style through AI”. Below the subtitle, include exactly 3 pill badges: “AI Fashion Designer”, “Digital Creator”, and “Visual Storyteller”, each with a small icon and purple gradient styling.

Creator Stats panel: Add one rounded glass panel titled “Creator Stats” with a small bar-chart icon. Inside it, show exactly 4 stat columns separated by faint vertical dividers: 28.6K Followers with a people icon, 1.2M Views with an upward trend icon, 176K Likes with a heart icon, and 320 Saved with a bookmark icon.

Content Pillars panel: Add one rounded glass panel titled “Content Pillars”. Inside it, show exactly 4 square gradient cards with icons and labels: “AI Fashion Design” with a dress mannequin icon, “Digital Lookbooks” with a sparkle icon, “Style Visuals” with a camera icon, and “Tips & Insights” with a lightbulb icon.

Aesthetic panel: Add one rounded panel titled “Aesthetic”. Include exactly 5 vertical thumbnail cards showing futuristic abstract/fashion imagery, each with a small rounded label underneath: “Futuristic”, “Minimal”, “Bold”, “Monochrome”, and “Dreamy”. Use purple, lilac, black, chrome, and soft blue color accents.

Toolkit panel: Place a narrower right-side rounded panel titled “Toolkit” with a small briefcase icon. List exactly 6 tools with recognizable small app-style icons and white text: Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, Photoshop, Blender, Runway, and Topaz Photo AI. Separate rows with subtle horizontal dividers.

Featured Post panel: At the bottom, create a wide rounded panel titled “Featured Post”. On the left, include one rectangular image preview of the same avatar in an iridescent coat standing in a surreal lavender futuristic architectural scene beside reflective water. On the right, add a small purple category pill reading “Digital Lookbook”, the post title “Cosmic Drift Collection”, and description text: “A fusion of futurism and fluidity. Exploring new dimensions of style with AI.” Add exactly 3 tag pills: “AI Fashion”, “Futuristic”, and “Lookbook”. At the bottom of this panel, show exactly 3 engagement metrics with icons: heart 12.4K, comment 460, bookmark 1.2K.

Visual style: 3D rendered social profile UI, dark glassmorphism, rounded rectangles, violet neon rim light, soft shadows, glossy gradient cards, crisp modern sans-serif typography, premium creator-branding aesthetic, highly detailed but clean and readable. Keep all text in English, maintain exact counts for badges, stat columns, content cards, aesthetic thumbnails, tools, tags, and engagement metrics. No watermark, no browser chrome, no extra panels, no extra text.\

prompt_en:
High-resolution mixed-media studio portrait combining photography with flat white hand-drawn vector doodles and collage overlays. Full-body shot of a confident young man on a vivid solid blue background, dressed head to toe in a monochromatic blue Adidas streetwear fit with crisp white details.

Subject: young man, light goatee, neutral confident expression, head tilted slightly left, body angled slightly right, right hand raised near his face, left leg crossed in front of the right. Low-angle full shot framed head to toe, 35mm-equivalent lens, deep depth of field, even soft front-right studio lighting in neutral white, gentle self-shadows on the left side of face and neck.

Outfit:
- Royal-blue denim/canvas bucket hat (#003399), brim pulled slightly down, visible white contrast stitching around brim and crown.
- Open vivid-blue sherpa fleece jacket (#0044CC), nubby high-pile texture, silver snap on the collar, sleeves slightly pushed up.
- Royal-blue cotton T-shirt underneath with a large white Adidas Trefoil outline printed across the chest.
- Dark-wash indigo relaxed-fit jeans (#2A3B55) with heavy white contrast stitching along seams and pockets, cuffs rolled up showing the lighter inside of the denim.
- Pristine all-white Adidas Superstar sneakers (smooth leather upper, rubber shell toe, three white-on-white stripes); right foot planted, left foot up on the toe.

Flat white hand-drawn vector overlays (sharp edges, doodle aesthetic, no shading):
- Three thick vertical white lines dropping from his raised hand down to a hand-drawn dynamic vocal microphone (mic-drop motif).
- An isometric outlined boombox to his center-right showing speaker mesh, handle, buttons, cassette deck.
- A large flat white Adidas Trefoil logo in the bottom-right corner.
- Short radiating motion/sound stroke lines around his head and the boombox.
- Jagged shattered-glass crack lines fanning out across the floor under his feet.

Behind him: amorphous flat liquid-blob shapes in a slightly more saturated blue (#5CAFF0) wrapping around the subject as a secondary background layer over the solid blue base.

Composition: subject centered, asymmetrical balance from the doodles filling the negative space, high-contrast and dynamic. Color palette strictly vivid blue, deep blue, and pure white. Sharp boundary between the photoreal subject and the flat 2D vector overlays so they read as layered, not blended. Vibe: energetic, urban, artistic, cool, album-cover energy.\
